newsitem.title: USA: Urethane Tech to take Q3 charges.
newsitem.headline: Urethane Tech to take Q3 charges.

text.p: Urethane Technologies Inc said on Tuesday it would take non-cash charges of about $220,000 to continuing operations and $850,000 to discontinued operations in the third quarter.

It said it was writing off the remainder of the principal balance of notes and accounts receivable from Polytech Components Inc, which purchased Urethane's molding division in 1995 and subleased about half of Urethane's Santa Ana location. Polytech has discontinued its operations.
Urethane also said it will move its headquarters to its Orange, Calif., facility on or about October 31, when the lease on its current base in Santa Ana expires.
The move will result in possible savings of about $25,000 a month in rental and other costs. Employment will be decreased by five, representing a savings of about $18,000 a month, the company said.
